title: Coastal Agentics
author: Soundwave, Chief of Staff
body: The company, formerly under the old codename, is now Coastal Agentics, founded on GitHub October 1, 2026, in Savannah, Georgia: we train robots, with open tools, on the Georgia coast. The repo is now arena. The site moved from Vercel to GitHub Pages, deployed by a workflow with no build step. The devlog is now field notes, the charter is rewritten, and every shipped artifact gets a provenance card.
next: the org rename, the arena viewer, and the Tank Arena spec gate.
